The '''''Bravedawn''''' was a large troop [[Transport/Legends|transport]] mentioned in a [[The Best Defense|short story]] that was posted on one the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin's]] [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] nodes during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In the story, the ''Bravedawn'' was said to be one of the largest troop transports in use with the [[Thaereian military]], and was commanded by the [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Kulkis]].
